cleaning_steps.reason: byte-identical feature rows carry no additional information and are a known leakage vector across splits
cleaning_steps.risk: duplicate removal may preferentially hit one class and shift class balance
cleaning_steps.alternative: retain duplicates and instead prevent cross-split duplication in the splitter

cleaning_steps.reason: labels not declared benign and not in the dataset's known-attack allow-list are UNKNOWN; they are rejected, never relabelled BENIGN
cleaning_steps.risk: a label typo in the contract would reject real attack rows; the audit surfaces this as an unexpected rejection count
cleaning_steps.alternative: map unknowns to ATTACK (would inflate recall) or BENIGN (forbidden)

cleaning_steps.reason: a negative flow duration is physically impossible; the rate features derived from it would be meaningless
cleaning_steps.risk: if the column is actually unsigned and overflowed, dropping hides a parse bug
cleaning_steps.alternative: take absolute value (rejected: masks data corruption)

split_manifest.rationale: random stratified split; no timestamp/group column assumed for this dataset

checks.method: exact match on feature vectors rounded to 6 decimals
checks.limitation: rounding-based proxy; cannot detect all near-duplicates

checks.detail: no group column supplied or present
no timestamp column supplied or present

checks.method: sequences are built independently within each split; index_origin is recorded per sequence
